# School_Management_System

> A learning-focused school administration and fee management platform built with ASP.NET Core, Blazor Interactive Server, EF Core, and MySQL.

## Project documents

- [README](README.md): current repository status, planned stack, and module overview
- [Implementation plan](plan.md): architecture, roles, data model, workflows, calculations, and seven-phase roadmap
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): implementation workflow, coding guidance, and data-protection rules
- [Full AI context](llms-full.txt): expanded project summary
- [MIT License](LICENSE): repository license

## Current status

Phases 1–5 are implemented in source and their migrations are applied to the configured local MySQL database. Phase 2 includes applications, private documents, role-protected review, enrollment, and student directory tools. Phase 3 includes teacher assignments, one-time attendance registers, correction approval, scoped daily/monthly reports, and guardian-linked parent attendance. Phase 4 includes academic terms, exams, teacher-scoped marks, review and publication, configurable grade bands, linked-parent report cards, and reasoned revisions. Phase 5 includes fee assignments, invoice and discount workflows, partial collections, receipts, SSLCOMMERZ sandbox payment/refund integration, overdue reminder drafts, and financial reports. The solution builds; the Phase 2–5 browser workflows still need manual walkthroughs. Sandbox credentials/public callback setup and Phase 6 communications, imports/exports, and deployment remain outstanding.
